ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Alibaba warns about hard-coding the AccessKey without splitting the warning between the two halves, so neither half is treated as public here.

ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET.description: The other half. Setting both makes them the default credential in Alibaba's provider chain.

ALIBABA_CLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN.description: Set all three and the chain uses a temporary STS credential instead, which expires on its own.
